title: Semio Design Split Layout Always For Mcp
description: SemioDesign collapsed to single-column diagram when hasPlanes false even on correct surface. Added splitLayout auto|always, pure semioDesignGridTemplateColumns + semioDesignShowSceneColumn, McpDesignViewer passes always. Tests assert two columns never 1fr when always.
summary: Root cause of full-width diagram in design-viewer: SemioDesign used hasPlanes to hide the scene column and grid 1fr, so users saw diagram-only even when McpDesignViewer mounted SemioDesign. Added SemioDesignSplitLayout (auto|always), pure semioDesignGridTemplateColumns + semioDesignShowSceneColumn (unit-tested: always+no planes => two columns not 1fr), data-semio-design-columns on root. McpDesignViewer passes splitLayout=always for design surface. vitest 179/179 passed.
